standings.title: Standings
standings.ladderDescription: Unlock higher standings by meeting the specific criteria for each level, with your standing evaluated separately for each scenario. Achieve these milestones to advance and demonstrate your growing expertise.
standings.mandatoryNote: Important: All mandatory criteria must be completed to receive a standing (if any).
standings.openCall: Open the call like "Dear Mr/Ms/Mdm, I am <Name of CA/SCA>, CA/SCA from UOB. Is this a convenient time for you to talk?"
standings.askPermission: Ask permission like "Before I proceed further with the call, may I do a simple verification with you to ensure that we're speaking to the intended recipient of this call?"
standings.verifyCustomer: Verify customer information by asking at least 2 eligible information
standings.partiallyApply4C: Partially apply 4C framework which consists of:
standings.captureDescription: Get the prospect's attention by suggesting a hot or trending topic currently in the news.
standings.contextDescription: Build rapport, frame the conversation, and acknowledge the client's situation with a relatable scenario or thought-provoking questions.
standings.conflictDescription: Identify and highlight potential financial risks to create urgency using pointed questions to prompt the client to consider consequences.
standings.proposeFollowUp: Propose a clear solution and secure a follow-up meeting to discuss the client's specific needs.
standings.secureFollowUp: Secure a follow-up meeting to discuss the client's specific needs.
standings.achieveObjectionBeginner: Achieve at least 'Beginner' for Objection Handling
standings.apply4CScripted: Apply all the 4C framework steps in a scripted manner, e.g., reading the script word-for-word without adapting to the client's responses or showing real understanding (See 'Sales novice' criteria for 4C framework explanation).
standings.achieveObjectionIntermediate: Achieve at least 'Intermediate' for Objection Handling
standings.apply4CDynamically: Apply the 4C framework dynamically, e.g., adjusted tone and phrasing based on the client's cues, asked clarifying questions, and naturally integrated the steps into the conversation (See 'Sales Novice' criteria for 4C framework explanation).
standings.achieveObjectionExpert: Achieve at least 'Expert' for Objection Handling

clientCentricFraming.title: Client-Centric Framing
clientCentricFraming.description: Demonstrates a strong understanding of the client's specific situation and frames the conversation in a way that aligns with their needs, concerns, and goals. The conversation should feel tailored and relevant to them.

clarityAndStructure.title: Clarity and Structure
clarityAndStructure.description: Provides clear, well-structured explanations that are easy to follow. Uses appropriate pacing and ensures the client understands each step before moving forward. Avoids jargon unless client-appropriate.

suitabilityAndCompliance.title: Suitability and Compliance
suitabilityAndCompliance.description: Demonstrates proper attention to suitability, ensuring that recommendations align with the client's financial situation, goals, and risk appetite. Maintains adherence to regulatory requirements and ethical standards.

gravitasAndDelivery.title: Gravitas and Delivery
gravitasAndDelivery.description: Conveys confidence, professionalism, and expertise in delivery. Maintains a composed and authoritative presence that instills trust and credibility with the client.

engagementAndRapport.title: Engagement and Rapport
engagementAndRapport.description: Actively engages with the client, demonstrates genuine interest in their needs, and builds rapport throughout the conversation. Uses appropriate empathy and responsiveness to create a positive client experience.

greeting.title: Greeting
greeting.description: Opens the call professionally and warmly
items: Greets the client by name and confirms their identity appropriately
Introduces self and role clearly
Sets a positive and professional tone for the call

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.description: Establishes the purpose and agenda of the call
items: Clearly states the reason for the call
Provides a brief overview of what will be covered
Checks for client's availability and consent to proceed

clientUpdate.title: Client Update / Discussion
clientUpdate.description: Engages the client in the core conversation
items: Shares relevant updates or information clearly
Asks appropriate discovery or clarifying questions
Listens actively and responds to client needs and concerns
Provides tailored insights or recommendations

notes.title: Notes
items: If applicable, mentions or confirms any follow-up actions or notes

callToAction.title: Call to Action
items: Suggests a specific action or next step (e.g., scheduling a meeting, reviewing documents)
Confirms client's agreement or addresses any hesitations

bonus.title: Bonus
bonus.description: Goes above and beyond to provide additional value, such as sharing relevant insights, resources, or proactive recommendations that enhance the client experience.

accuracy.title: Accuracy
accuracy.description: Represents HSBC products, services, and policies accurately
items: Provides correct and up-to-date information about HSBC offerings
Avoids misleading statements or overpromising
Aligns recommendations with HSBC's guidelines and best practices

toneOfVoice.title: Tone of Voice
items: Warm, professional, and confident
Adjusts tone appropriately based on client's cues
Maintains energy and enthusiasm throughout the call

dictionAndClarity.title: Diction and Clarity
items: Speaks clearly and at an appropriate pace
Avoids excessive jargon or complex terminology
Ensures client comprehension before moving forward

engagementAndListening.title: Engagement and Listening
items: Actively listens and responds to client's needs
Demonstrates empathy and understanding
Encourages client participation and questions
